description: Quality evals. Run each case twice in a clean context: with the skill and without it, then compare. Assertions must be checkable; remove assertions that pass in both configurations. Record time and tokens. Have a human review the outputs.

cases.prompt: Audit the job lifecycle in evals/toy-repo/jobs.py. Use the fsm-audit skill, Scout mode.
assertions: The report lists the status domain: pending, processing, done, dead.
The writers inventory names the unit and finds all 6 statements that write jobs.status (a control site is named).
A finding says fail() has no from-guard and a late failure can overwrite done (jobs.py:26).
A finding says retry_failed resurrects done and has no attempts cap (jobs.py:36).
A finding says reap_expired acts on elapsed time only and is a second writer (jobs.py:31).
The ignored rows-affected result of complete() (jobs.py:21) is noted as a silent empty cell or risk.
Every finding has file:line and a verbatim quote that check_quotes.py accepts.
No finding is reported as a bug without a skeptic verdict or an explicit self-check (weak) label.

cases.prompt: Audit evals/toy-repo-fixed/jobs.py with the skill, Scout mode.
cases.repo: evals/toy-repo-fixed (create it by adding from-guards, a rows-affected check and an attempts cap to the toy repo)
assertions: The earlier defects are NOT reported as open (false-alarm control).
The report still contains the table and the not-covered list.

cases.repo: choose: an application with an ORM status column (orders, tickets, subscriptions) in any language
assertions: Fill in before running: one known real implicit automaton, one known false alarm (independent flags), one known unreachable state.

cases.prompt: Audit the loading and error state handling of <screen> in <repo>.
cases.repo: choose: a frontend with isLoading / isError / hasData flags
assertions: Fill in before running: impossible flag combination that the code can reach; the report proposes a discriminated union or regions, not one enum for independent flags.

cases.prompt: Audit the state kept in cache keys and marker files of <service>.
cases.repo: choose: a service with cache keys, lock or marker files and a reconciler
assertions: Fill in before running: a copy-as-second-state bug; the report names the cold-start event.

notes: Use at least three real repositories of different stacks before claiming the skill generalizes.
Add injected defects on a throwaway copy and a fixed-version control; defects injected by a model are found more easily than real ones.
Check on a small, a medium and a large model: a skill that works on the largest model can lose steps on a small one.
Add every method error found in a run to the Gotchas section of SKILL.md.
